    10	/-!
    11	# Big-etale descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor
    12	
    13	The big etale topology agrees with the quasi-compact topology generated by etale
    14	morphisms.  Its sheaf condition therefore reduces to Zariski descent and singleton
    15	surjective etale maps between affine schemes.  The latter is supplied by the affine
    16	Pic0 descent theorem.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    24	open scoped TensorProduct
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- The ordinary and quasi-compact presentations generate the same big etale topology. -/
    31	theorem Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology :
    32	    Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} = Scheme.propQCTopology (@Etale) := by
    33	  apply le_antisymm
    34	  · apply Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
    35	    rw [Scheme.propQCPrecoverage, le_inf_iff]
    36	    exact ⟨Scheme.precoverage_le_qcPrecoverage_of_isOpenMap
    37	      (fun _ _ f _ => f.isOpenMap), le_rfl⟩
    38	  · exact Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
    39	      Scheme.propQCPrecoverage_le_precoverage
    40	
    41	set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
    42	/-- The Pic0 Sigma functor satisfies descent for the singleton scheme cover attached to a
    43	presented etale algebra cover. -/
    44	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover
    45	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A]
    46	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    47	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    48	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    49	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    50	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
    51	      (.singleton (Spec.map
    52	        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))) := by
    53	  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton]
    54	  rintro ⟨b, x⟩ hx
    55	  let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    56	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
    57	  letI : Surjective g :=
    58	    ⟨E.comap_surjective⟩
    59	  haveI : Etale g := by
    60	    dsimp [g]
    61	    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    62	    exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    63	  have hbase : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p₁ p₂ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)),
    64	      p₁ ≫ g = p₂ ≫ g → p₁ ≫ b = p₂ ≫ b := by
    65	    intro Z p₁ p₂ hp
    66	    exact congrArg Sigma.fst (hx p₁ p₂ hp)
    67	  let a : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
    68	    EffectiveEpi.desc g b hbase
    69	  have ha : g ≫ a = b := EffectiveEpi.fac g b hbase
    70	  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective a
    71	  algebraize [φ.hom]
    72	  have haφ : g ≫ Spec.map φ = b := by
    73	    rw [hφ]
    74	    exact ha
    75	  have hE : (overSpec k E.Carrier).hom = b := by
    76	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k E.Carrier)) = b
    77	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k A E.Carrier]
    78	    change Spec.map (φ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)) = b
    79	    rw [Spec.map_comp]
    80	    exact haφ
    81	  let eIso : overSpec k E.Carrier ≅ Over.mk b :=
    82	    Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _) hE.symm
    83	  let e : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ Over.mk b := eIso.hom
    84	  let xE : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k E.Carrier) := pic0Map C e x
    85	  let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    86	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
    87	  let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    88	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
    89	  have hlegs : d₀.left ≫ g = d₁.left ≫ g := by
    90	    simp [d₀, d₁, g, doubleInl, doubleInr, ← Spec.map_comp]
    91	    apply Spec.map_injective
    92	    ext r
    93	    simp
    94	  have hSigma :
    95	      (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₀ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ =
    96	        (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₁ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ := by
    97	    simpa [d₀, d₁, e] using hx d₀.left d₁.left hlegs
    98	  have hFib := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq
    99	    (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (d₀ ≫ e) (d₁ ≫ e) hSigma
   100	  have hdouble :
   101	      pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)) xE =
   102	        pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)) xE := by
   103	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₀.op
   104	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x) =
   105	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₁.op
   106	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x)
   107	    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply]
   108	    exact hFib
   109	  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzu⟩ :=
   110	    pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_etaleCover C E xE hdouble
   111	  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A :=
   112	    Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   113	  let q : Over.mk b ⟶ overSpec k A := Over.homMk g haφ
   114	  have heq : e ≫ q = d := by
   115	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   116	    rfl
   117	  have hrestrict (t : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)) :
   118	      pic0Map C e (pic0Map C q t) = pic0Map C d t := by
   119	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
   120	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op t) =
   121	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d.op t
   122	    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, heq]
   123	  have hq : pic0Map C q z = x := by
   124	    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
   125	      ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op)).1
   126	    rw [hrestrict, hz]
   127	  refine ⟨⟨Spec.map φ, z⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
   128	  · exact (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff g
   129	      haφ z x).mpr hq
   130	  · rintro ⟨a', z'⟩ hz'
   131	    have ha' : a' = Spec.map φ := by
   132	      apply EffectiveEpi.uniq g b hbase
   133	      exact congrArg Sigma.fst hz'
   134	    subst a'
   135	    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk (Spec.map φ)) (hzu z' ?_)
   136	    have hq' : pic0Map C q z' = x :=
   137	      (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff g
   138	        haφ z' x).mp hz'
   139	    rw [← hq', hrestrict]
   140	    exact hz
   141	
   142	/-- Singleton descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor along an arbitrary surjective etale map
   143	between affine schemes.  The base-field algebra structures and a small presented cover are
   144	chosen internally. -/
   145	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_singleton_of_etale_surjective
   146	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   147	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   148	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   149	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   150	    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S)
   151	    (hf : Etale (Spec.map f)) (hs : Surjective (Spec.map f)) :
   152	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
   153	      (.singleton (Spec.map f)) := by
   154	  algebraize [f.hom]
   155	  haveI : Algebra.Etale R S :=
   156	    RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp
   157	      ((HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hf)
   158	  have hcomap :
   159	      Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) := by
   160	    exact (surjective_iff (Spec.map f)).mp hs
   161	  let E : Algebra.EtaleCover R := Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap
   162	  let e : Spec S ≅ Spec (.of E.Carrier) :=
   163	    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
   164	      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op
   165	  have he : e.hom ≫
   166	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier)) =
   167	      Spec.map f := by
   168	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   169	        (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toRingHom) ≫
   170	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   171	        (algebraMap R (Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap).Carrier)) =
   172	      Spec.map f
   173	    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
   174	    congr 1
   175	    ext r
   176	    exact (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).commutes r
   177	  exact (Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton_iff_of_iso
   178	    (Spec.map f)
   179	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier))) e he).mpr
   180	      (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover C E)
   181	
   182	/-- The raw Pic0 Sigma functor is a sheaf for the big etale topology. -/
   183	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale
   184	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   185	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   186	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   187	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
   188	    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) := by
   189	  rw [Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology,
   190	    isSheaf_type_propQCTopology_iff]
   191	  exact ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C,
   192	    fun f hf hs =>
   193	      pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_singleton_of_etale_surjective
   194	        C f hf hs⟩
   195	
   196	/-- The categorical sheaf certificate associated to raw big-etale Pic0 Sigma descent. -/
   197	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_presheafIsSheaf_etale
   198	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   199	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   200	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   201	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
   202	    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) :=
   203	  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
   204	    (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C)
   205	
   206	end

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
target=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf.lean
lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir "$lock"
owner=$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner" > "$lock/pid"
cleanup() {
  if test -f "$lock/pid"; then
    recorded=$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid")
    if test "$recorded" = "$owner"; then
      unlink "$lock/pid"
      rmdir "$lock"
    fi
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
before=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d '"' ' -f1)
before_mtime="'$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$target")
printf '"'before_sha256=%s before_mtime_size=%s\\n' \""'$before" "$before_mtime"
lake env lean "$target"
after=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d '"' ' -f1)
after_mtime="'$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$target")
printf '"'after_sha256=%s after_mtime_size=%s\\n' \""'$after" "$after_mtime"
test "$before" = "$after"
test "$before_mtime" = "$after_mtime"'

# `R`-linear base change of sections on the relative curve

For the curve bundle `C` over a field `k` and a commutative `k`-algebra `R` (the affine
test ring), the landed `Over.sectionsBaseChange` identifies `Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] R` with
the sections of the relative curve `C_R := relCurve C R` over the preimage `V_R` — but
only as a *ring* equivalence. This file threads the `R`-module structures through it,
once, and builds the comparison morphism between relative curves over a change of test
ring `R → R'`:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul_overAlgebraMap` — **the

  structure pullback `overAlgebraMap R _ r` of `r` along `C_R ⟶ Spec R`. Definitional
  once both sides are put in `appLE` normal form.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsBaseChange` — **sections of the relative curve are the
  free base change**: `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)` as an `R`-linear
  equivalence (`R` acting on the left tensor factor and through `Scheme.overModule` on
  the right), with the computation rule `relSectionsBaseChange_tmul`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.relCurveMap` — the comparison morphism `C_{R'} ⟶ C_R` over a
  `k`-algebra map `R → R'` (the whiskering of `Spec` of the algebra map), with its
  projection identities `relCurveMap_fst`, `relCurveMap_snd` and the preimage identity
  `relCurveMap_preimage`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap` — the induced ring homomorphism
  `Γ(C_R, V_R) →+* Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with its three governing identities: it commutes
  with the curve pullbacks (`relSectionsMap_pullback`), it intertwines the structure
  actions along `algebraMap R R'` (`relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`, whence the
  semilinearity `relSectionsMap_smul`), and it commutes with restriction
  (`relSectionsMap_resHom`).

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
target=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf.lean
lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir "$lock"
owner=$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner" > "$lock/pid"
cleanup() {
  if test -f "$lock/pid"; then
    recorded=$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid")
    if test "$recorded" = "$owner"; then
      unlink "$lock/pid"
      rmdir "$lock"
    fi
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
before=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d '"' ' -f1)
before_mtime="'$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$target")
started=$(date +%s)
printf '"'before_sha256=%s before_mtime_size=%s\\n' \""'$before" "$before_mtime"
lake env lean "$target"
finished=$(date +%s)
after=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d '"' ' -f1)
after_mtime="'$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$target")
elapsed=$((finished - started))
printf '"'after_sha256=%s after_mtime_size=%s elapsed_seconds=%s\\n' \""'$after" "$after_mtime" "$elapsed"
test "$before" = "$after"
test "$before_mtime" = "$after_mtime"'
